review_candidates.title: TCMS SW Engineer
review_candidates.description: 📍 Sede: Pistoia | 🕐 Contratto a tempo indeterminato | 🍽 Ticket Restaurant + Welfare | Candidature aperte anche alle categorie protette (artt. 1 e 18 - L. 68 /99) M CA Group è una multinazionale di consulenza ingegneristica presente in 7 Paesi: Italia, Francia, Belgio, Germania, Olanda, Svezia e Spagna. Con oltre 800 talenti nel mondo e circa 200 in Italia, siamo partner strategico dei principali player nei settori ad alto contenuto tecnologico. Crediamo in una crescita concreta e meritocratica: offriamo un career path strutturato, con obiettivi chiari e formazione continua, per valorizzare competenze e aspirazioni di ogni persona. In Italia siamo presenti con sedi a Torino, Milano e Roma, operando nei settori Mobility & Digital. 🎯 Siamo alla ricerca di un TCMS SW Engineer per progetti in ambito Railway. 💻 L’attività prevede: Progettazione e sviluppo software per sistemi di controllo e monitoraggio dei treni (TCMS). Modellazione e sviluppo di algoritmi di controllo tramite MATLAB e Simulink (Model-Based Design). Analisi dei requisiti funzionali di sistema e loro traduzione in specifiche e architetture software. Esecuzione di attività di test e validazione software in ambiente di simulazione (MIL/SIL/HIL). Interfaccia con team multidisciplinari per garantire l'integrazione del software con l'hardware di bordo e l'architettura di veicolo. Revisione della documentazione tecnica di sviluppo SW secondo gli standard normativi del settore ferroviario. 🎯 Il Profilo che cerchiamo: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Elettronica, Meccatronica, Automazione o discipline affini. Esperienza di almeno 1 anni nello sviluppo software embedded/controllo in ambito railway o settori ad alta affidabilità. Ottima conoscenza dell'ambiente MATLAB/Simulink e delle metodologie Model-Based Design. Conoscenza delle architetture e dei protocolli di comunicazione TCMS. Conoscenza dei principali standard normativi per lo sviluppo software ferroviario (es. CENELEC EN 50128). Conoscenza di strumenti di gestione requisiti (es. DOORS). Eccellenti soft skills, inclusa la capacità di ascolto attivo, comunicazione chiara, gestione delle relazioni e orientamento al risultato. 🤝 Quello che ti offriamo: Contratto a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Per profili con almeno 1 anno di esperienza, è prevista una retribuzione iniziale a partire da €30.000, commisurata alle competenze tecniche e all'esperienza maturata, con un percorso di crescita strutturato. Per profili con maggiore seniority, la proposta retributiva verrà definita nel corso dell'iter di selezione, sulla base dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del nostro Career Path. La progressione economica avviene secondo i livelli previsti dal CCNL. Buoni pasto da 10 € e piano Welfare commisurato alla seniority aziendale Un Career Path strutturato, basato su criteri oggettivi e verificabili, che ti accompagnerà nella crescita professionale all'interno di MCA Italia Un ambiente internazionale e una cultura aziendale orientata all'innovazione e alla collaborazione 💡 Non ti riconosci in tutti i requisiti? In MCA Italia crediamo nel potenziale delle persone e nella crescita continua. Se il ruolo ti interessa e pensi di poter portare valore con le tue competenze e la tua motivazione, ti invitiamo comunque a candidarti , anche se non rispecchi al 100% i requisiti indicati. ⚖ ️ Pari Opportunità, Privacy e Trasparenza Promuoviamo una cultura aziendale fondata sul rispetto, sull’inclusione e sulla valorizzazione delle persone. Nel processo di selezione le candidature sono valutate esclusivamente sulla base di competenze, esperienze e attitudini professionali, senza alcuna discriminazione, diretta o indiretta, legata a genere (L. 903/77 e L. 125/91) , età, origine etnica, orientamento sessuale o altre caratteristiche non rilevanti ai fini della valutazione. I dati personali raccolti sono trattati con riservatezza e nel rispetto della normativa vigente in materia di protezione dei dati personali, del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679, delle procedure interne e del Codice Etico aziendale. Le persone candidate sono invitate a consultare l’Informativa Privacy, ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del GDPR, disponibile al seguente link: h ttps://mca-website.cdn.prismic.io/mca-website/aCG1jSdWJ-7kR6kA_MGR-INF-RM002-ENGDataProtectionPolicy.pdf L ’annuncio è rivolto anche a candidat* appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli artt. 1 e 18 della L. 68/99.

review_candidates.title: System Safety Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Railway Assurance Ltd, known as the Railway Safety Experts, is a dynamic team of experienced and approachable professionals dedicated to ensuring public safety across the railway sector. The company supports a wide range of high-profile projects including HS2, Transpennine Route Upgrade, Northern Rail, and major station developments such as Victoria Phases 3, 4, and 5. Railway Assurance Ltd is recognized for cost-effective safety management processes and specialized assurance services that set it apart in the industry. The organization embraces projects of all sizes and maintains a comprehensive overview of its services and contact details at railwayassurance.co.uk, offering opportunities to work on diverse and impactful rail safety initiatives. Role Description The System Safety Engineer will play a key role in developing, assessing, and maintaining safety and assurance activities for railway systems and infrastructure. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing system safety analyses, supporting hazard identification and risk assessment, managing safety requirements, and contributing to safety cases and assurance documentation for ongoing and new projects. The role involves close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and project teams, reviewing technical designs and operational procedures for safety compliance, and providing clear, evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders. The System Safety Engineer will also help improve safety processes and tools, participate in audits and reviews, and stay current with relevant standards and regulations. This is a full-time remote role, requiring proactive communication, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients in distributed teams. Qualifications Strong System Safety and Safety Engineering skills, including hazard analysis, risk assessment, and safety case development. Proficiency in Systems Engineering and Requirements Management, with experience defining, tracing, and validating safety-related requirements. Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret complex technical data, assess safety impacts, and develop practical, robust solutions. Experience in or exposure to rail, transport, or other safety-critical industries, with familiarity with relevant standards and regulations (e.g., CENELEC, ISO-based frameworks). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear safety documentation and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple tasks, and meet project deadlines with high attention to detail. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Systems Engineering, Safety Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Professional certifications or training in system safety, functional safety, or railway assurance are an advantage.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world. We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world. We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025). We are looking for a Senior Treasury Specialist to join our team. Your main tasks will be: Payment operations: preparation and execution of payments across group banks and payment providers USA/EU/Asia SWIFT/SEPA/ACH/Crypto; FX execution; KYC and bank documentation: requests from banks, document packages for account openings and reviews; Account and signatory register: keeping it complete and up to date; Support the Head of Treasury in bank projects and account openings (administrative side); Gradual takeover of the operational functions of the Treasury team. We expect from you: Payment operations (SEPA/SWIFT/ACH); E-banking platforms and payment providers; KYC and bank documentation; Account and signatory register management; Payment controls and approval rules; Strong Excel; Russian proficiency level: C1+; English proficiency level: B2+ What do we offer: REMOTE OPPORTUNITY  to work full-time; The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment; Vacation  28 calendar days per year; 7 wellness days per year  (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave; Bonuses up to $5000  for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company; 50%  payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings; Corporate discount for  English lessons; ​ Health benefits.  According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children); ​ Workplace organization.  The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years; Internal gamified gratitude system:  receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.  Sounds good? Join us now!

Perform a technical leadership role within the project team, ensuring the quality of the developed code. Provide consulting to clients following the company’s software implementation methodology. What You Bring To The Team Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field. Experience in T-SQL (SQL Server) or PL/SQL (Oracle) programming queries and stored procedures (minimum of 4 years of experience). Experience in relational database modeling (SQL Server/Oracle). Experience with mainstream programming languages such as C#, Python, Java, or TypeScript. Experience with REST/SOAP Web Services using XML and JSON. Minimum of 7 years of experience in the role. Strong teamwork skills, initiative, versatility, and discipline to meet deadlines and goals. Availability to travel. Advanced level of English. Eligible for the CLT employment model. Preferred Qualifications Intermediate Spanish. Experience in technical leadership in software development. Experience with reporting tools (e.g., SSRS) and label generation tools (e.g., BarTender). Knowledge and experience in the Supply Chain and distribution sector. Experience in WMS (Warehouse Management System) implementation projects. What We Do for You Work with a global leader in supply chain software solutions. Participate in challenging implementation projects for industry-leading clients. Collaborate with skilled professionals in a dynamic and innovative environment. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Help shape the future of supply chain technology. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better. We believe the future is better when supply chains work better. review_candidates.title: Senior Project Manager
review_candidates.description: About Us: Network International is the largest Financial Technology company in Middle East and Africa. Payments is our core business where we provide services in more than 50 countries – UAE, Jordan, South Africa, Egypt are some of our key markets. Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we are growing in direct to consumer card segment as well. Our EVP: At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team. L’organisation valorise la collaboration, la proximité avec ses partenaires et une culture d’amélioration continue. Rejoindre SAA Algérie, c’est intégrer une structure en évolution, ouverte aux initiatives et aux profils engagés. Description du poste : En tant que Responsable des opérations événementiel, vous pilotez la préparation, l’organisation et le suivi des événements internes et externes de SAA Algérie. Vous coordonnez les différentes parties prenantes (équipes internes, prestataires, partenaires) et veillez au respect des objectifs, des délais et des budgets. Au quotidien, vous gérez le planning des opérations, assurez la logistique, suivez les contrats fournisseurs et contrôlez la qualité de l’expérience proposée aux participantes. Ce poste est à temps plein et s’exerce en mode hybride : basé à Alger, avec la possibilité d’effectuer une partie des missions en télétravail. Compétences en Event Planning : aptitudes à planifier, organiser et superviser des événements de différentes tailles et formats. Compétences en Communication : excellente communication écrite et orale, capacité à travailler avec des interlocutrices variées et à diffuser des informations claires. Compétences en suivi budgétaire et bureautique seraient appréciées: savoir établir, suivre et optimiser les budgets événementiels, avec une attention au contrôle des coûts.

review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance (QA) & Training Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Company Description CsMena is a professional company specializing in Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), technology-enabled services, and digital solutions. Through innovation and continuous investment in technology, CsMena delivers scalable solutions that help organizations improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and accelerate digital transformation Since 2018, we have delivered top-tier outsourcing services with a focus on exceptional call center operations. Our dedicated team undergoes rigorous training to ensure the highest quality service for our clients in various industries including E-commerce, healthcare, telecommunications, and hospitality. We offer multilingual support through different communication channels to ensure client satisfaction and loyalty. We are seeking a results-driven QA & Training Supervisor to lead, standardize, and continuously improve our quality assurance and employee training functions. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience applying COPC Customer Experience (CX) Standards across both QA and training departments, paired with a strong background in Six Sigma methodologies to drive measurable operational improvements. Key Responsibilities COPC Framework Implementation : Lead the ongoing application, alignment, and auditing of COPC standards across all Quality Assurance and Training workflows to ensure full operational compliance and service excellence. Quality Assurance Management: Oversee the QA team in designing evaluation forms, conducting call/interaction audits, leading calibration sessions, and delivering actionable feedback to frontline agents and team leaders. Training & Onboarding Delivery: Manage end-to-end training programs—including new-hire onboarding, product/process updates, and targeted refresher coaching—ensuring training modules directly address QA findings. Process Improvement (Six Sigma): Identify recurring performance gaps, conduct root-cause analyses, and lead end-to-end Six Sigma improvement projects to reduce defects, improve CSAT/NPS, and boost First Contact Resolution (FCR). Team Leadership & Coaching: Supervise, mentor, and evaluate QA Analysts and Trainers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accuracy, consistency, and accountability. Reporting & Stakeholder Alignment: Track and present departmental KPIs, audit trends, training effectiveness metrics, and project outcomes to senior management. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field. Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in a contact canter or BPO environment, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role overseeing QA and/or Training. Mandatory: Proven, hands-on experience implementing and applying COPC standards directly within Quality Assurance and Training departments. Mandatory: Demonstrated experience applying Six Sigma tools and methodologies to lead and execute process improvement projects from scoping to completion. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/data reporting tools to translate audit and training data into operational action plans. Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications (Advantage) COPC Certified (e.g., COPC Implementation Leader or Registered Coordinator). Six Sigma Certified (Green Belt or Black Belt). What We Offer Competitive salary package. Opportunity to shape the marketing function of a growing BPO organization. Exposure to global clients and international markets. Professional development opportunities. Dynamic and innovation-driven work environment.
